documentedFacts.fact: bgra8Unorm_srgb is an8-bit BGRA normalized format with conversion between sRGB and linear space. Pixel format is not a promise about scene lighting or tone mapping.

CIImage colorSpace option declares the image source color space and overrides an implicit color space. Supplying NSNull disables image color management; it is not documented as a brightness-correction mechanism.

CIContext color-manages source into its working space, then working into destination space. Default working space is extended linear sRGB. The explicit createCGImage destination colorSpace parameter controls output encoding.

CIImage(mtlTexture:) accepts supported2D textures and exposes image options. Its public page and local header do not specify that sRGB texture sampling plus an sRGB colorSpace option performs two independent gamma decodes.
The Core Image texture initializer does not expose a flipped Boolean; image transforms/orientation APIs are separate. Vertical orientation and color transfer are independent operations.

assessment.sourceEncoding: For an image whose stored RGB data is sRGB encoded, declaring the CI source sRGB and requesting sRGB output is consistent with the documented source→linear-working→destination color-management model. Two appearances of the word sRGB do not themselves prove duplicate gamma decoding.
assessment.missingBridgeContract: These retrieved primary contracts do not reveal how Core Image internally handles the Metal texture view/sampler relative to its source color-space conversion. Therefore I cannot assert either a double-decode bug or complete end-to-end correctness from signatures alone.
assessment.darkness: Darker output remains an observation reported by root. No pixel sampling was done. Source texture interpretation, RealityRenderer/RealityView lighting/environment, exposure/tone mapping and compositing can affect appearance; no one cause is established here.
assessment.orientation: Reported vertical inversion is a separate presentation/coordinate mismatch and provides no evidence for gamma duplication. No transform implemented by this audit.
assessment.notRecommended: No arbitrary brightness/gamma filter, disabling color management, linear relabeling or light-intensity compensation is justified by this documentation alone.
